library.title: Library rules
library.text: Our library opens at nine. You can check out two books. You have to show your card. You can read a comic at the library, but you can’t take one home.

bus.title: Before and on the bus
bus.text: Wait in line to get on the bus. You can choose any free seat. You have to stay seated while the bus is moving. You can’t eat on this bus.

uniforms.title: Photo day
uniforms.text: Leo and Ana have to wear white shirts and black shoes for the photo. A tie is optional. They can bring a jacket, but they don’t have to wear it in the photo.

trip.title: Zoo trip checklist
trip.text: The trip is on Friday. Bring a signed form and a water bottle. Lunch is provided. Stay with your group and ask the guide before you take a picture.

plan.title: Mia’s study plan
plan.text: Mia wants to read one page by Friday. Leo will listen to her for five minutes every day. On Thursday, she will practise at the library.

first-day.title: Leo’s first day
first-day.text: On his first day, Leo carries three books. One falls in the hall. Mia picks it up and carries it for him. Then Leo asks where to eat. Mia shows him the cafeteria. Leo thanks her.

photo-day.title: Two schools, two rules
photo-day.text: Ana has to wear a white shirt and black shoes for her school photo. At Sam’s school, clothes can be any color. Sam wears a teal T-shirt and jeans. They both have to arrive before nine for the photo.

boat-school.title: A classroom on the water
boat-school.text: A small school boat stops by the river each morning. The children have to wait for their teacher before they get on. They can read and write at little desks inside. After class, the boat takes them home.

forest-school.title: A lesson under the trees
forest-school.text: Ana and Leo have lessons in a forest. Today they draw leaves in their notebooks. It rains and the ground gets muddy. They have to wear boots, but they don’t have to stay indoors. They sit on a dry bench.

tree-school.title: A tree in the classroom
tree-school.text: There is a tree in the middle of this classroom. It grows through a hole in the roof. Students read under its branches. Outside, there is a big slide. Children can use it after class, if their teacher says yes.

zoo-trip.title: Trip to the zoo
zoo-trip.text: The class visits the zoo on Friday. Everyone has to bring a signed form and a water bottle. The teacher has extra notebooks, so bringing one is optional. At the zoo, the children can ask the guide questions.
